summary: Vesta Real Estate Corporation, S.A.B. de C.V. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a global offering of 70,047,634 common shares, including 11,992,850 ADSs (each representing 10 common shares) in an international offering and 58,054,784 shares in a Mexican offering. The public offering price per ADS is $34.62, with total proceeds before expenses of approximately $234.3 million. The closings are conditional on each other. Over-allotment option of up to 10,507,140 additional ADSs is available for 30 days. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
